name: Goenka Business & Finance Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1987, Goenka Business & Finance Ltd is in the business of lending and
 investments.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
GBFL is registered and classified as a non-systematically important non-deposit-taking Non-Banking Finance Company. It is engaged
 in the business of providing loans and making investments.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.37 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 6.36% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 1.93% over last 3 years.
